tenacity 9.2.1 was published on PyPI on 2026-10-07.
stamina 26.1.0 was published on PyPI on 2026-04-13.

conclusion: jd/tenacity (Apache-2.0) and hynek/stamina (MIT) are maintained at 2026-10-31; litl/backoff (MIT, archived, last commit 2023-01-20), invl/retry (Apache-2.0 by file reading, last commit 2016-05-12) and rholder/retrying (Apache-2.0, last commit 2016-06-07) are not.
